name: Buenavista Equity Partners
prepared_for: the Buenavista Ventures team in Lisbon
facts: Seed in Portugal, Series A in Spain
Proprietary tech and disruptive digital models
position: Buenavista Ventures, formerly GED Ventures, is the venture arm of Buenavista Equity Partners, with about €150M under management. Its Portuguese Tech Seed fund backs seed and post-seed companies with ANI-certified R&D in digital, health and clean tech, while the Spanish fund leads Series A rounds in software, fintech, e-commerce and AI. The team supports founders on strategy, commercial, HR and international expansion.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your Portuguese seed portfolio is full of AI products that now need to find and keep customers, like Sqill, Full Venue, PluggableAI and Pleez, and that's exactly the stage I help with.
summary: Buenavista supports its founders on strategy, commercial execution and international expansion, which is the work a senior Product & RevOps operator does day to day. I've spent nine years in tech on B2B and B2C products, from KYC and fraud at 14M-user scale to ad tech and customer operations in New York, across Hong Kong, New York and Lisbon. Your martech, fan-engagement, fraud and geospatial companies match my background, and I can work alongside your Lisbon team, freelance or full-time.

reasons.title: Audience, content and ad tech
reasons.body: Sqill, Full Venue and PluggableAI sell to marketing, media and sports teams. I've worked on ad platforms from both sides and built growth reporting for those buyers.

reasons.title: Fraud, payments and location
reasons.body: Feedzai, Kushki and Ritmo live on payments and risk; Xoople and Troop on geospatial and travel data. I've owned KYC at 14M-user scale and a geofencing platform at HEROW.

reasons.title: International by default
reasons.body: I've worked in Hong Kong, New York and Lisbon and speak French, English and Portuguese, a fit for your support on international expansion.

vc_notes.thesis: Digital and AI overlap well; health, biotech and clean tech much less.
vc_notes.stage: Seed in Portugal and Series A in Spain: the stages where product and RevOps matter most.
vc_notes.platform: Strategic, commercial, HR and international-expansion support from a 15-person team.
